questions.prompt: Should the Notebook landing page keep the existing URL (site root `/`), or move to a dedicated `/notebook/` path?
questions.description: Today "Notes" in the nav points at `/` (the home layout, which blends `_posts` and the `_notes` collection). Renaming the nav label to "Notebook" is free either way, but changing the URL changes what's canonical for search engines and any existing bookmarks/backlinks.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Keep it at `/` — only rename the nav label and update the page's own title/framing.

options.label: Move to `/notebook/` (root becomes a redirect or something else)

questions.prompt: Inside Notebook, should blog-style `_posts` and the `_notes` collection stay blended into one feed (as today), or split into two visible sub-areas (e.g. "Notes" and "Posts")?
questions.description: You said Notes lives inside Notebook. The home page currently interleaves both collections without distinguishing them.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Keep them blended as one Notebook feed — introducing a Posts/Notes split is a separate, later concern.

options.label: Split into distinct Notes / Posts sub-areas now

questions.prompt: How should the Prompt Library be represented as a project?
questions.description: It already lives at `/prompts/` via the `_prompts` collection + `prompt-bench.html` (sliders UI). Moving its URL under `/projects/...` would touch the collection's permalink config and the recent prompt-bench work; keeping its own URL and just adding it as a card in `_data/projects.yml` (same pattern as the SFL Engine project) is much less disruptive.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Add a Prompt Library card to `_data/projects.yml` pointing at the existing `/prompts/` URL — no change to the `_prompts` collection, its permalinks, or the prompt-bench UI.

options.label: Add a projects.yml card pointing at existing /prompts/ URL

questions.prompt: Confirm the new top nav: just "Projects" and "Notebook" (removing the standalone "Prompts" link, since it's now reached via the Projects card)?
questions.description: Current nav.html has three links: Notes, Projects, Prompts.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Yes — two links only: Projects, Notebook.

options.label: Keep a direct Prompts nav link too, in addition to the project card

questions.prompt: Where should the better-layout skill's thinking (grouping, reading order, progressive disclosure) actually get applied in this goal?
questions.description: Scoping this avoids the plan ballooning into a full visual redesign.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Nav component and the Notebook/Projects landing pages — not a full visual redesign of every page.

options.label: Individual project card layout in projects.yml-driven grid

questions.prompt: You mentioned wanting to expand the interactive pedagogical sliders eventually — is that expansion in scope for this goal, or purely a future intent to note for later?
questions.description: Keeping it out of scope keeps this goal focused on the IA restructure.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Out of scope for this goal — just the IA/nav restructure and the Prompt Library project card.

options.label: Out of scope — note it for a future goal
In scope — sketch initial expansion now
